title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Sales Tax Bulletin — Tax on a Disputed Amount Settled in the Business's Favor
content:
When an approved invoice dispute on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is settled, the dispute settlement credit includes the sales tax added back on the disputed amount. The tax added back is set by the disputed invoice and the dispute category, read from the invoice line the dispute names (its sales tax, its merchandise amount and its invoice total) and from the category recorded on the dispute request.

## Rule

| The disputed invoice | Dispute category | Tax added back on the disputed amount |
|---|---|---|
| Charged sales tax (its sales tax is above zero) | Wrong price or wrong quantity | The disputed amount is treated as merchandise: the disputed amount times the invoice's sales tax, divided by the invoice's merchandise amount |
| Charged sales tax | Merchandise not received or unauthorized buyer | The disputed amount is treated as part of the invoice total: the disputed amount times the invoice's sales tax, divided by the invoice total (the invoice amount including its sales tax) |
| Charged no sales tax | Any | No tax is added back |

The tax added back enters the dispute settlement credit as computed, without being rounded on its own; the dispute settlement credit is rounded to the nearest cent on its total.

## Worked figures (hypothetical invoice)

An invoice has a merchandise amount of 2000.00, sales tax of 160.00 and an invoice total of 2160.00. The disputed amount is 500.00.

- Wrong price: 500.00 times 160.00, divided by 2000.00, is 40.00 added back.
- Merchandise not received: 500.00 times 160.00, divided by 2160.00, is 37.037037 added back (unrounded).
- The same dispute on an invoice invoiced tax-exempt, with no sales tax charged: nothing is added back, whatever the category.

## Points of judgement

- The category is the one recorded on the approved dispute request.
- The sales tax, merchandise amount and invoice total are the figures on the disputed invoice line itself.
